user_decision: 2026-10-11: major revision. Official EigenAttention (with 45% stop) is the Uniform baseline at 0.8/0.7/0.6x; FDP-EB and Spectral-tail use the official pipeline without the 45% stop, matched to the official Uniform cache size; Severe adds a fourth setting where all arms run without the 45% stop. New FDP formula without d2. Stop early if FDP-EB is not best at Light or Medium. Delete each checkpoint after its evaluations (manifest first). All 3 GPUs may be used.

pipeline.official_variant: upstream unchanged (45% rank stop: loop continues only while rank_kq > 0.45*1024 and rank_v > 0.45*1024)
pipeline.no45_variant: code/upstream_no45: one line changed in decompose/eigen_attn.py (Llama branch loop condition): the 45% rank stop is replaced by the threshold floor 'threshold > 0.3' used by the upstream OPT/MPT branches; everything else byte-identical (diff recorded)
pipeline.calibration: WikiText-2 train, 512 x 2048, seed 2, upstream datautils (audited windows sha 1b6ad8b1...)
pipeline.per_layer_budget_adapter: args.error_budget set to eb[i] right before upstream decompose_llama_layer(i) (shim item 5)

fdp_formula.q: q_l = MinMax_l( Z_rel_mse_l + max(0, -entropy_diff_A_l) )   (d2 = score_rel_mse_causal removed)
fdp_formula.budget: eps_raw_l = base/(1+1.2 q_l); eps_l = base * eps_raw_l / mean(eps_raw); layer 0 frozen to base
fdp_formula.profile_source: frozen step1_diagnose_llama.py (bf16, seqlen 512, 2 seqs), Dense vs the setting's Uniform checkpoint; Light/Medium/Aggressive reuse FDP_OFFICIAL_PROTOCOL_V1/tiers/<t>/step1.json (parent = official Uniform at eb 0.045/0.060/0.090, identity-gated against the official reproduction)

spectral_tail: tails at the setting's Uniform ranks with the upstream (avg_dim 4) eigenvalues: QK = sum(eval_kq[r_QK/8:])/sum(eval_kq), V = sum(eval_v[:, r_V/8:])/sum(eval_v); score = MinMax(0.5 QK + 0.5 V); then exactly the FDP budget mapping (lambda 1.2, mean-normalised, layer 0 = base) and the no45 search

Severe.uniform: no45, single eb = the replayed point whose B is nearest to 151,289,856 bytes (0.5636x of 268,435,456)

resource_matching.method: exact CPU replay of the upstream loop (fp16 'error < eb' comparison) on the recorded no45 full trace (dense-propagated inputs make each layer's curve independent of the budget); every replayed schedule is re-checked against its materialized checkpoint (gate: identical ranks)
resource_matching.rule: scan the scalar base over all breakpoints; eligible if |B - B_U| <= 0.15% of B_U; choose the smallest |gap|, ties -> base closest to the official tier eb (Severe: to the Uniform eb). If none eligible: the closest point with B <= B_U within 1% (NEAR_MATCHED, never more cache than Uniform)

evaluation.ppl: ppl_instrumented.py (sha ffe4e52e), WikiText-2 141 / C4 256 windows, bf16
evaluation.official_uniform_reuse: OFFICIAL_EIGENATTN_REPRO_V1/eval/p_eb0p0{45,60,90}_ns512_ad4_save (same runners; window ids/input sha and sample ids are asserted equal before any comparison)
evaluation.paired_bootstrap: PPL: 10,000 window replicates PCG64 20261012/20261013; accuracy: 10,000 item replicates within task PCG64 20261014

stop_condition.stage: after Light and Medium FDP-EB and Spectral-tail are evaluated (before Aggressive, Severe and ablations)
stop_condition.rule: STOP if, at Light or at Medium, FDP-EB's point estimate is worse than Uniform or worse than Spectral-tail on J or on the five-task average accuracy. Per-dataset (WikiText-2, C4) results are reported but do not trigger the stop.
stop_condition.on_stop: no further GPU jobs; report to the user

ablations_after_pass.matching: each arm matched to the same Uniform B with the rule above (no fixed-budget comparisons)

cleanup: a checkpoint is deleted only after all its evaluations are persisted and validated; per-file size+SHA256 manifest and low_rank_config are kept
no_retuning: lambda, normalisation, layer-0 rule, matching rule and stop condition are frozen; no formula or hyperparameter changes after quality results
